name: data-platform-database-dto-wave18-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: Database DTO behavior is recorded from the local API 67 runtime and makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.

evidence.notes: CursorFetchResult is constructed and its clone returns a distinct runtime object.
CursorFetchResult constructor is invoked before a distinct clone assertion.
CursorFetchResult.clone returns a distinct object.
DeletedRecord.deleteddate round-trips a nondefault date.
DeletedRecord.equals distinguishes two records with different state.
DeletedRecord.hashCode produces distinct identity hashes for distinct records.
DeletedRecord.id round-trips a nondefault record ID.
DeletedRecord.toString includes configured record state.
DuplicateError instances participate in substantive identity and string assertions.
DuplicateError constructor is invoked before distinct-object assertions.
DuplicateError.equals distinguishes two instances.
DuplicateError.hashCode produces distinct identity hashes for distinct instances.
DuplicateError.toString includes its runtime type.
Error.equals distinguishes errors with different configured state.
Error.hashCode produces distinct identity hashes for distinct errors.
Error.toString returns the configured nondefault message.
GetDeletedResult.earliestdateavailable round-trips a nondefault date.
GetDeletedResult.equals distinguishes configured and empty results.
GetDeletedResult.hashCode produces distinct identity hashes.
GetDeletedResult.toString includes configured deleted records.
GetUpdatedResult.equals distinguishes configured and empty results.
GetUpdatedResult.hashCode produces distinct identity hashes.
GetUpdatedResult.toString includes configured IDs.
MergeRequest.equals distinguishes a configured request from an empty request.
MergeRequest.hashCode produces distinct identity hashes.
MergeRequest.toString includes configured merge IDs.
MergeResult is configured with a nonempty error list.
MergeResult constructor is invoked before configuring its error list.
MergeResult.errors round-trips a nonempty list containing a configured Error.
PaginationCursor.clone returns a distinct object.
UnitOfWork.clone returns a distinct object.

source.content: Database.DeletedRecord deletedA = new Database.DeletedRecord(); Database.DeletedRecord deletedB = new Database.DeletedRecord(); deletedA.deleteddate = Date.newInstance(2026,1,2); deletedA.id = '001000000000001AAA'; deletedB.deleteddate = Date.newInstance(2026,1,3); deletedB.id = '001000000000002AAA'; System.assertEquals(Date.newInstance(2026,1,2), deletedA.deleteddate); System.assertEquals('001000000000001AAA', deletedA.id); System.assertEquals(false, deletedA.equals(deletedB)); System.assertNotEquals(deletedA.hashCode(), deletedB.hashCode()); System.assert(deletedA.toString().contains('id=001000000000001AAA')); System.assert(deletedA.toString().contains('deleteddate=Date:')); Database.DuplicateError duplicateA = new Database.DuplicateError(); Database.DuplicateError duplicateB = new Database.DuplicateError(); System.assertEquals(false, duplicateA.equals(duplicateB)); System.assertNotEquals(duplicateA.hashCode(), duplicateB.hashCode()); System.assert(duplicateA.toString().contains('Database.DuplicateError:{')); Database.Error errorA = new Database.Error(); errorA.fields = new List<String>{'Name'}; errorA.message = 'required'; errorA.statuscode = System.StatusCode.REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING; Database.Error errorB = new Database.Error(); errorB.fields = new List<String>{'Email'}; errorB.message = 'invalid'; errorB.statuscode = System.StatusCode.FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION; System.assertEquals('Name', errorA.fields[0]); System.assertEquals('required', errorA.message); System.assertEquals('REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING', String.valueOf(errorA.statuscode)); System.assertEquals(false, errorA.equals(errorB)); System.assertNotEquals(errorA.hashCode(), errorB.hashCode()); System.assertEquals('required', errorA.toString()); Database.GetDeletedResult deletedResultA = new Database.GetDeletedResult(); Date earliest = Date.newInstance(2026,1,1); deletedResultA.deletedrecords = new List<Database.DeletedRecord>{deletedA}; deletedResultA.earliestdateavailable = earliest; deletedResultA.latestdatecovered = Date.newInstance(2026,1,4); Database.GetDeletedResult deletedResultB = new Database.GetDeletedResult(); System.assertEquals(earliest, deletedResultA.earliestdateavailable); System.assertEquals(1, deletedResultA.deletedrecords.size()); System.assertEquals(false, deletedResultA.equals(deletedResultB)); System.assertNotEquals(deletedResultA.hashCode(), deletedResultB.hashCode()); System.assert(deletedResultA.toString().contains('deletedrecords=List[')); Database.GetUpdatedResult updatedA = new Database.GetUpdatedResult(); updatedA.ids = new List<Id>{'001000000000001AAA'}; updatedA.latestdatecovered = Date.newInstance(2026,1,4); Database.GetUpdatedResult updatedB = new Database.GetUpdatedResult(); System.assertEquals(1, updatedA.ids.size()); System.assertEquals(false, updatedA.equals(updatedB)); System.assertNotEquals(updatedA.hashCode(), updatedB.hashCode()); System.assert(updatedA.toString().contains('ids=List[')); Database.MergeRequest mergeA = new Database.MergeRequest(); mergeA.setRecordToMergeIds(new List<String>{'001000000000001AAA'}); mergeA.setMasterRecord(new Account(Name='Master')); Database.MergeRequest mergeB = new Database.MergeRequest(); System.assertEquals(false, mergeA.equals(mergeB)); System.assertNotEquals(mergeA.hashCode(), mergeB.hashCode()); System.assert(mergeA.toString().contains('recordtomergeids=List[')); Database.MergeResult mergeResult = new Database.MergeResult(); mergeResult.errors = new List<Database.Error>{errorA}; System.assertEquals(1, mergeResult.errors.size()); Database.CursorFetchResult fetch = new Database.CursorFetchResult(); System.assertNotEquals(fetch, fetch.clone()); Database.PaginationCursor pagination = new Database.PaginationCursor(); System.assertNotEquals(pagination, pagination.clone()); Database.UnitOfWork work = new Database.UnitOfWork(); System.assertNotEquals(work, work.clone());
